scope: P6 manuscript Claims, versioned EvidenceLinks to exact SourcePassages, owner review decisions, stale-link invalidation, and Vue claim-to-passage UI

findings.evidence: The approved local-only access model has one owner; current Manuscript is a JSONB document with optimistic version; SourcePassage is immutable and points to a concrete SourceFile. User decisions recorded in TASK-011 scope Claims to manuscript assertions and exclude author's research results.
findings.impact: Evidence review has one accountable reviewer and remains distinct from citation and extraction. Source file identity and passage provenance are not copied into an inferred proof state.
findings.exit_condition: TASK-011 acceptance evidence proves owner-scoped operations, typed relations, concrete versions and explicit review decisions.
findings.next_action: Keep study results, shared reviewers and role management out of P6.

findings.evidence: GitNexus impact for SourceFileReferenceRecord is MEDIUM with a lower-bound dispatch boundary; direct imports are document, identity, library, manuscript and project repositories. Source inspection confirms the generic reference table stores per-domain reference type/id and the library replacement flow marks old file references needs_review. ManuscriptService impact is LOW, with the owner-scoped manuscript API as a direct caller.
findings.impact: Adding Evidence references must preserve existing passage retention/review behavior. The graph result is not complete across repository interfaces, so the implementation keeps those consumers unchanged and checks source/test behavior directly.
findings.exit_condition: Integration tests prove evidence retains its exact file, old file version exposes needs_review, and existing library/document tests pass.
findings.next_action: Use the generic reference mechanism and avoid changing library upload/delete semantics.

findings.evidence: Current Tiptap persistence keeps only one JSONB snapshot and an integer version. P6 uses a selection position anchored to the saved manuscript version; evidence links capture Claim and manuscript versions. Claim or manuscript mutation invalidates the links; explicit owner review binds the decision to current versions.
findings.impact: A position is not a stable block identity across edits. Invalidation prevents stale review from being presented as current; historical manuscript snapshots and automatic position migration remain out of scope.
findings.exit_condition: The UI displays the anchored version/position and requires review after manuscript changes; later persistent block IDs require a separate contract.
findings.next_action: Treat navigation coordinates as version-scoped locators, not permanent block IDs.
